title: Nurturing Pungent Thai Apricots Khanom Thai
description: A dairy‑free kid‑friendly Thai hot‑pot featuring rehydrated apricots in a spicy coconut broth, served with al dente rice noodles and a cheese‑pull mouthfeel.

ingredients.name: dried apricots
ingredients.notes: soaked in hot water for 10 minutes then drained

instructions: Rinse dried apricots, soak in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain and chop into bite-sized pieces.
In a pot, heat vegetable oil over medium heat, add minced garlic, grated galangal, and smashed lemongrass, cooking until aromatic.
Stir in tamarind paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, and red chili flakes, letting the mixture simmer for 2 minutes.
Add chopped apricots, coconut milk, lime juice, and kaffir lime leaves, seasoning with salt to taste, and bring to a gentle simmer.
While the broth simmers, blanch rice noodles in boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Ladle the simmering apricot broth into the hot‑pot vessel, placing the blanched noodles at the bottom.
Let the hot pot steam for 3 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the noodles to absorb the broth.
Transfer the hot pot to a heat‑resistant serving dish, sprinkle fresh cilantro on top for garnish.
Serve immediately, letting kids dip noodles into the fragrant, pungent broth for a cheese‑pull mouthfeel.
